name: stencil-stc
description: Write Stencil .stc scripts with syntax highlighting, live diagnostics from the real engine, and one-key Run — batch crops, filters, layouts and annotations over whole folders of images without leaving the editor.

commands.title: Stencil: Run script on an image…

stencil.cliPath.markdownDescription: Path to the Stencil CLI binary, used by the run commands and by the check on save. A relative path is taken from the workspace folder. Empty falls back to `STENCIL_CLI`, then `stencil` on `PATH`.

stencil.checkOnType.markdownDescription: Re-check the script while typing, using the in-process parser. Saving always checks: with the CLI's `--script-check` where a binary is found, with the same in-process parser where none is.

stencil.checkOnSave.markdownDescription: Check a saved file with the Stencil CLI's `--script-check`, so the editor answers with the same compiled engine that runs the script. Off spawns nothing: the in-process parser answers on save as well, and it sees everything but what only the engine can.

stencil.highlighting.markdownDescription: Colour `.stc` words by the statement they sit in. Needs `#editor.semanticHighlighting.enabled#`. Off leaves the plain TextMate grammar, which still colours directives, numbers, strings and comments. To recolour rather than disable, use `#editor.semanticTokenColorCustomizations#`.

stencil.completion.markdownDescription: Suggest the directives, filter modes, stroke styles, crop edges, colour names, units and templates that are legal at the caret. When the list appears is `#editor.quickSuggestions#` and `#editor.suggestOnTriggerCharacters#`.

^(source|template|templateName|edit|outp.patternErrorMessage: A hex colour — #rgb, #rgba, #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa — or "" to leave the family to the theme.

templateName.description: a template's name, where defined and where used

lineStyle.description: solid dashed dotted fill point combine replace

stencil.colors.markdownDescription: An exact colour per kind of word, as `#rgb`, `#rgba`, `#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa` — for example `{ "filterMode": "#ff8800" }`. A family left out, or set to an empty string, keeps whatever the colour theme gives it. This is painted on top of `.stc` alone, so it wins over the theme and over `#editor.semanticTokenColorCustomizations#`, and it applies with no reload.

stencil.hover.markdownDescription: Explain the directive or keyword under the pointer: its meaning, argument grammar and an example. Needs `#editor.hover.enabled#`.
